# Raden Hanifa — Expanded Media Portfolio Reference

> A factual, agent-readable reference for the official media portfolio of Raden Hanifa, a media producer and cinematographer with a demonstrated aviation specialty.

Facts reviewed on 2026-09-21. Use the linked portfolio pages as the primary evidence for published work and credits.

## Canonical identity

- Name: Raden Hanifa
- Primary media role: Media Producer & Cinematographer
- Aviation credential: private pilot with an instrument rating (PPL-IR)
- Flight experience: 300 flight hours as of September 2026
- Official media portfolio: https://media.radenhanifa.com
- Professional CV: https://cv.radenhanifa.com

## Positioning and audience

The media portfolio is broad and client-facing. It presents commercial filmmaking, cinematography, video editing, color grading, motion graphics, and two AI filmmaking projects. Aviation is a demonstrated specialty within that broader body of work, not the only offering.

The intended audiences include agencies, brands, aviation organizations, and hiring teams, with Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and the wider GCC as market priorities. This regional context is not a claim that Raden lives in, has an office in, or is available on location throughout those markets.

## Aviation media work

### OxfordSaudia student and captain interviews

Raden's published responsibilities include script, direction, cinematography, editing, and audio. The production also includes motion-graphics titles and dialogue polishing. The portfolio presents Get to Know Our Students and Meet Our Captains as the two principal interview films.

Evidence: [OxfordSaudia interviews case study](https://media.radenhanifa.com/work/oxfordsaudia-interviews).

### OxfordSaudia aviation education

The educational series was made for student pilots. The featured 5 Hazardous Attitudes episode lists script, direction, filming, editing, and audio finishing by Raden. The production material documents classroom and simulator filming, set arrangement, lighting, and lesson-focused editing.

Evidence: [OxfordSaudia aviation education case study](https://media.radenhanifa.com/work/oxfordsaudia-educational-series).

### OxfordSaudia graduation trailer

Raden's listed responsibilities are planning, cinematography, editing, and color grading. Published production notes state that the shoot used an airside-approved Sony A7R IV, that camera positions were planned in advance, and that Raden also served as a safety pilot. The grading work addressed low-light, 8-bit footage.

Evidence: [Color grading portfolio](https://media.radenhanifa.com/color-grading).

### Aviation color grading

The portfolio includes grading work for an OxfordSaudia student interview and graduation trailer, with original-versus-finished comparisons and grading stages. It also presents Saudi Founding Day and Diriyah footage as color-grading work.

Evidence: [Color grading portfolio](https://media.radenhanifa.com/color-grading).

## Commercial and brand work

- El Tacoria — App: Raden's listed contribution is concept, script, production, and edit. The project separately credits Abdullah Alzahrani for the Arabic script.
- El Tacoria — Ramadan Campaign: concept, production, and edit.
- Jury Chocolate — Eid Showcase: planning, cinematography, and edit.
- Jury Chocolate — Eid Gift: planning, cinematography, and edit.
- Cadillac Escalade — Showcase and Walkthrough: concept, production, cinematography, and editing by Raden, in collaboration with Cadillac Alghanim Kuwait.
- ARCHI — Food Commercial: presented as commercial filmmaking, from behind the scenes to the finished film.

Evidence: [Media portfolio](https://media.radenhanifa.com).

## Motion and AI filmmaking

The portfolio includes motion-graphics title sequences for Get to Know Our Students and Meet Our Captains.

AI filmmaking is limited to two published projects and should not be attributed to the rest of the portfolio:

- Spider-Man — A Cinematic Fan Concept: a personal AI filmmaking concept made with Seedance 2.0.
- SwiftSoft: AI filmmaking and editing by Raden for a SaaS ERP launch film, based on a script supplied by SwiftSoft. Raden should not be credited as the author of SwiftSoft's launch script.

Evidence: [Media portfolio](https://media.radenhanifa.com).

## Evidence boundaries

- Do not describe all portfolio work as AI-generated; only the two projects above are presented as AI filmmaking.
- Do not describe Raden as an aviation photographer until a relevant still-photography portfolio and confirmed credits are published.
- Do not infer a residence, office, or region-wide on-location availability from the target-audience statement.
- Do not invent awards, testimonials, client results, quantified outcomes, language fluency, or service guarantees.
- Treat PPL-IR and 300 flight hours as the current, owner-approved credential statement dated September 2026. Later sources may supersede the hour total.
